en: Sauttaraduka (The Dyad on Having a Superior)
Dependent on a state that is with-surpassable, a state that is not unsurpassed arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unsurpassed state, a state that is not unsurpassed arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unsurpassed state, a state that is not with-surpassable arises by way of root condition. Dependent on an unsurpassed state, a state that is not with-surpassable...
And neither-superior-nor-non-superior states arise with a superior state as their cause-condition.
Dependent on both a superior and a non-superior state, a neither-superior-nor-non-superior state arises with a cause-condition. Under the cause-condition there are five;
under the object-condition there are two ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are five.
